grey-oak: Business data on the signup-only account: the Prospect Tracker, Blueprint sheets, and brand files sit on the greyoakventures@gmail.com Drive. Move them to nick@greyoakventures.com as proposed.

The live greyoakventures.com is served from a branch of the Michigan Salt repo, by a Render service named 'sandbox'. A push to the wrong branch could change the wrong site. Consider giving it its own repo and service.
Private pages rely only on noindex. robots.txt allows everything, so anyone with the link can open them.
Two CRM sheets: the Prospect Tracker and an older Side Hustle CRM. Retire the old one if unused.
DMARC is p=none (monitor only), so others could spoof the domain. Tighten once mail is stable.
The auto-reply routine has no confirmed owner bot.
michigan-salt: Sandbox server (michigansalt-sandbox) is a paid $7/mo starter service last changed Sep 22. Suspend it or move it to free if it is idle.
Ops server: render.yaml says free plan + 1 GB disk, but the live service is starter with no disk showing. Check that orders survive a redeploy.
Invoicing overlap: QuickBooks (live), Homeworks (old docs), and Stripe (unused, 0 products). Pick one and retire the rest.
OSRM public demo server has no uptime promise. The quote falls back to an estimate if it is down.

grey-oak.title: Visit
grey-oak.detail: A prospect opens the private Walkthrough link. Porkbun DNS points to Render, Render's CDN serves the page, and GoatCounter counts the visit.

grey-oak.title: Request
grey-oak.detail: They fill in the Walkthrough request form. FormSubmit receives it.

grey-oak.title: Alert
grey-oak.detail: FormSubmit emails a 'New Walkthrough request' table to nick@greyoakventures.com.

grey-oak.title: Auto-reply
grey-oak.detail: An automatic reply goes out from nick@greyoakventures.com and the thread gets labeled.

grey-oak.title: Book
grey-oak.detail: The prospect picks a time on the Walkthrough Call booking page, and it lands on the Grey Oak calendar.

grey-oak.title: Walkthrough
grey-oak.detail: Nick does the on-site day and follows up by hand. The follow-up email series is drafted but not launched.

michigan-salt.title: Visit
michigan-salt.detail: Customer opens michigansalt.com. Porkbun DNS points to Render, Render's CDN serves the static pages, and GoatCounter counts the visit.

michigan-salt.title: Quote
michigan-salt.detail: Customer enters address, sack count, and forks. The server turns the ZIP into a map point, gets driving miles from OSRM, and returns one all-in delivered price.

michigan-salt.title: Request
michigan-salt.detail: Request this load. The site saves the lead and forwards it with a shared secret to the ops board, which saves it in SQLite.

michigan-salt.title: Alert
michigan-salt.detail: Ops emails an order alert through Resend to the hudsonville@ inbox (watched by Mr. McFeely).

michigan-salt.title: Invoice
michigan-salt.detail: An invoice is created in QuickBooks Online through Zapier and emailed to the customer. Nick approves.

michigan-salt.title: Pay
michigan-salt.detail: Customer pays by QBO pay page, ACH, check, or wire. No card payments on the site.

michigan-salt.title: Ship
michigan-salt.detail: Mr. Krabs confirms cleared funds, then the truck is scheduled. The ops board moves the order to paid, scheduled, and delivered.
